cohort: 590 newborns hospitalized in a tertiary NICU in Heidelberg, Germany, with at least one nasal screening swab positive for S. aureus
finding: Nasal colonization with S. aureus was significantly associated with S. aureus infection in a non-outbreak NICU setting.
mod_finding: This study on Staphylococcus aureus infections in newborns found that cesarean delivery was not significantly associated with colonization.
